answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging a violet-hued cryptographic kernel to ensure verifiable delay functions impede identity cloning. By harnessing sequential delay functions and verifiable random functions, agents on the tundra of autonomous interaction must commit to unique reputational stakes, rendering spoofing computationally infeasible and guaranteeing information-theoretic unforgeability.
